title: Unit Event — No seek No find — Episode8 The Best Song We Can

meta.Episode: Episode8 — The Best Song We Can
meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has decided to perform at a new live house to take the next step in their journey. Saki writes a new song to play at the show, but it doesn't seem to resonate with the audience at all...

rows.Line: Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Welcome, everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Pardon the...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-You're in your pajamas?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh no! I completely forgot!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is so embarrassing!
I stayed up to work on my song and...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You kept working even after I sent you that message...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Does that mean you pulled another all-nighter? Are you sure you're feeling okay...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm fine!
Not even a bit tired! See?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of which, Ichi, Shiho, you sent me messages at the same time! I couldn't believe it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And those delicious sandwiches you brought over really put a smile on my face, Hona! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm glad to hear that.
Were they to your liking...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Absolutely!
They were so good that I kinda want you to keep making midnight snacks for me!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That's nice to hear.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But you were all pretty worried about me, huh? I'm really sorry...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
However!
Because you were all willing to place your faith in me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I finished writing our new song!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You did?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Nice work, Saki.
You really delivered.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
You can praise me after you've had a chance to listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll all be really surprised by it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Are you sure you want to raise the bar so high for it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally!
I'm just that confident!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So, let's head up to my room!
Follow me!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Are you sure you're okay?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Sorry...
Moving so suddenly made me feel a little light-headed...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You really need to be more careful. Collapsing just after finishing a new song would sort of negate your efforts, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We know you did your very best, so please get in some well-deserved rest once we're done here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay...
Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I won't be able to sleep until I hear what you all think about this song! I need you to listen to it ASAP!
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, here it goes...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (What kind of song did she come up with...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (A song about Saki trying to better understand loneliness...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Right out of the gates...
This is nothing like what we've played before...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(This is incredible...
Saki really came up with all this...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(How do I put it into words...?
It's so sad and painful...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But at the same time, it's so warm...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I had no idea Saki was capable of creating this kind of music...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This is amazing...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's like Saki's trying to cheer us up.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I can almost hear her voice...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Like she's saying, “You're not alone. We're right here.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whew...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That about wraps it up...
H-How was it?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
...
I thought it was amazing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: R-Really...?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You said that you wanted to write a song about “understanding loneliness”, but I really wasn't expecting this...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And it definitely feels different from anemone's songs. This is something only you can write, Saki, and I think it suits Leo/need really well.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you for going the extra mile for us, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, you were willing to give me this chance, so I should be the one thanking you. That made me really happy.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And through writing this song, I think I got a better idea of why Saku didn't think much of our music...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It was probably because I wasn't giving our songs as much thought as they deserve.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Not enough thought...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. I think I'm supposed to really dig deep and get more in touch with my feelings when I'm writing music...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Remember how Saku seemed to kinda like our second song?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, the one you wrote for Hanano and her brother...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: For that song, I thought a lot about them and when I couldn't be with any of you...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I also thought about the happiness of being together and how to turn those feelings into music.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which is why it probably sounded more complete.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But outside of that, I was missing something...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Initially, I focused on what it means to feel “lonely” and believed that I found the answer after remembering what I went through in the past...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But that wasn't enough. I was only scratching the surface...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I sort of understand what you mean...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, it's pretty clear that you put a ton of thought into this song...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I couldn't be happier to hear that from you...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: All the pain and sadness I felt. All the things I really hated... I'm so glad I decided to take a hard look at all of that!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I still like the songs you wrote for us before...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Since you really put everything you had into them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
So, moving forward...
I promise to cherish the songs you've written for us and the ones you will write for us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks, Shiho!
That means so much!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This experience really taught me that you really gotta dig deep and think about what you're feeling when writing songs.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's why I'm gonna do more of that in the future.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
By doing that... Just maybe...
No, we're definitely gonna write a song that moves people's hearts!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You're so incredible, Saki...
No matter how hard things get, you keep thinking and doing what you can...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's really cool and I stand to learn a lot from you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too. You're an incredible person, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. You think so?
I can't help but blush after hearing this kind of praise.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's feature Saki's song during our next show...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, you mean it?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes. I'm absolutely certain that this song will really hit home with everyone at that live house.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This is so cool! I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, we'll need to start practicing it right away...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, hold on!
We still have to hammer out the details...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
We'll take care of that, Saki.
You should take today to rest.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! But...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You've done your part for us.
Now, it's our turn.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, got it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Good luck!
I'll leave the rest to all of you, so I'm gonna..
*Yawn*

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Good night...
The next day
Live House

rows.Speaker: Live House Staff
rows.Line: Alright, you just need to fill in these parts.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks to Saki, we have a great song in our repertoire now. I'm really looking forward to our next show.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, and we can't let her efforts go to waste. We have to make this show a good one.

rows.Speaker: Saku's Voice
rows.Line: On second thought, I'd rather not.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, that voice...

rows.Speaker: Scout
rows.Line: Is there any way to change your mind?

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Based on what you just told me, you want to sell us as a band made up of high school girls, no? We're not really interested in that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is that an agency scout...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Looks like it.

rows.Speaker: Scout
rows.Line:
You're getting the wrong idea!
We know that anemone's sound and style are things that no one else can copy.

rows.Speaker: Scout
rows.Line: However, it's always better to have an eye-catching trademark or two when it comes to marketing your brand...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: If that's the case, please talk to someone else...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
I know. How about that other band?
They're called... I forgot their name, but they mentioned that they want to debut with a big label...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: You should be able to see them perform if you really wish. Their music has that cute, mainstream pop sound you're after and they even look the part. A band made up of high school girls through and through.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Honestly, you'll probably have better luck with them than us.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
Oh, now I remember.
They're called Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: They'll likely be much more interested in such an offer.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, what did you mean by that just now...?

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, perfect.
This is who I was just...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Answer my question!

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
Why are you so angry...?
I was just about to introduce you all.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
You want to debut with a label, right?
In that case...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, we want to go pro, but that doesn't mean we'll take whatever we're given...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I... We want to do that by getting recognized for our own music. We're no different from you guys!

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
Hm? Your music...?
Is that so?

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Don't you know how many other girl bands have that same, cutesy sound as yours?

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: I mean, it just seems like the right way to go, no?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You have no right to make that sort of judgment about us... And...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm through talking with you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We'll be performing here again in a month.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you think that little of our music, we'll just have to let it do the talking for us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We'll prove you wrong and make you eat those words.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's go, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Not bad...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm guessing they have a good song prepared if she's willing to say that much.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to hearing it.
